newsitem.title: USA: CV Reit to buy 22 strip malls for $110 mln.
newsitem.headline: CV Reit to buy 22 strip malls for $110 mln.

text.p: CV Reit Inc said Monday it has entered into a contract to acquire 22 strip shopping centers valued at approximately $110 million.

The company said it entered into the previously announced agreement with several private owners and entities for the acquisition of a commercial real estate management company, corporate offices and up to 22 strip shopping centers located primarily in eastern Pennsylvania and southern New Jersey. The agreement, said CV, provides for a 45 day due-diligence period and is subject to shareholder approval. The transaction is projected to close in September.

Hilcoast Development Corp the financial advisor to CV Reit, said that the transaction contemplates the formation of a limited partnership with CV Reit as the general partner. The company will either issue stock or partnership units in exchange for interests in real estate.
